items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: We were once on the road driving and I was in the car with Stirling, Jack was--no, Adie was driving and Jack was sitting next to her and Stirling and I were in the back seat

ctx.x: He was a Dixieland type player, but so beautifully; oh, he played so beautiful. He was such a pain in the ass otherwise.

We were once on the road driving and I was in the car with Stirling, Jack was--no, Adie was driving and Jack was sitting next to her and Stirling and I were in the back seat and Stirling kept cursing in his drunken stupor and Jack was saying, 'come on, Jack, calm down, there's a woman in the car, have a little respect.' 'Fuck you and fuck her and fuck this and fuck that.' So Jack said, 'Stirling,--now we're on a stretch of road in the South and you can't see anything in front or anything in back, nothing--and…

you out of the car." "I don't give a fuck, fuck you, fuck her," and they stopped the car and Jack pulled him out of the car and threw him on the road and they drove off and left him there. I couldn't believe it, and he appeared a couple of days later on the gig. I have no idea how he got there.
